title: Image subobject of a monomorphism
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], $A,M$ objects, and $f:A\to M$ a monomorphism. A subobject of $M$ is an isomorphism class of monomorphisms into $M$; write $[f]$ for the class of $f$. The image subobject $\operatorname{imSub}(f)$ is the class of the monomorphism in an image factorization of $f$: a factorization $f=i\circ e$ with $i$ monic which is initial among such factorizations. Such an image exists for a monomorphism. Then
$$\operatorname{imSub}(f)=[f].$$
